decision: I moved the shared steps (save, read back, mail, build the result) into one private helper, `saveAndSend`, and each of the three exported functions now makes one call to it. I kept the save-then-read-back step because ADR 0024 requires emails to be sent from the stored copy (Mira's decision, at the cost of one extra read per email). So I didn't remove that read. Exported names, arguments and return values are unchanged. `npm test` has no tests to run, so the change is untested.

recorded.info: Added private helper saveAndSend(shop, kind, key, html, subject), which saves the report, reads it back (ADR 0024), mails it and returns {shopId, kind, bytes}. sendDailyReport, sendWeeklyReport and sendCorrection are now one-line async wrappers that render and call the helper.
